  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in Africa, specifically addressing the East African Community (EAC) and the Southern African Development Community (SADC). For example, it mentions the need for harmonization of curricula to facilitate the free movement of labor within the EAC and SADC regions.",

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Curriculum harmonization is essential for promoting regional integration and facilitating the free movement of labor.",
      "Regional qualifications frameworks play a crucial role in ensuring the comparability of qualifications.",
      "Mutual recognition of qualifications is necessary for enhancing student and worker mobility."
